d: TJ disapproves of a competitor giving up during a challenge, alliances between women start falling apart, and Kayleigh surprises everyone by thinking for herself during an elimination.
Devin spills the tea about a secret hookup in the house that shatters alliances and tests loyalties, Natalie and Nelson form a new bond, and TJ makes it clear he doesn't condone bullying.
A competitor is shocked after being betrayed, setting off another betrayal at the hands of the Troika, and TJ brings back four Mercenaries to make the double elimination even harder.
Natalie makes a last-ditch effort to appease Nelson and make amends for past actions, and TJ announces where survivors of the upcoming double elimination will head for the final challenge.
A member of the Troika punishes a competitor for being verbally aggressive during the Inquisition and sends him off to the elimination, and new vendettas are formed leading up to the final.
TJ reintroduces two Mercenaries with the power to launch a grenade if they win a card game against the final challengers, and a twist makes the final winner-take-all.
Britni and Marie face off for the first time after insulting each other online, Kam gets kudos for her three elimination round wins, and Bananas and Tony reflect on their Challenge baggage.
